text: Permanence, perseverance and persistence in spite of all obstacles, discouragements, and impossibilities: It is this, that in all things distinguishes the strong soul from the weak.
author: Thomas Carlyle

text: Obstacles don't have to stop you. If you run into a wall, don't turn around and give up. Figure out how to climb it, go through it, or work around it.
author: Michael Jordan

text: Patience and perseverance have a magical effect before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish.
author: John Quincy Adams

text: A hero is an ordinary individual who finds the strength to persevere and endure in spite of overwhelming obstacles.
author: Christopher Reeve

text: Stand up to your obstacles and do something about them. You will find that they haven't half the strength you think they have.
author: Norman Vincent Peale

text: Love conquers all difficulties, surmounts all obstacles, and effects what to any other power would be impossible.
author: William Godwin

text: One who gains strength by overcoming obstacles possesses the only strength which can overcome adversity.
author: Albert Schweitzer

text: There are plenty of difficult obstacles in your path. Don't allow yourself to become one of them.
author: Ralph Marston

text: When there's a setback, some people throw in the towel, others pull out all the stops.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: Obstacles are those frightful things you see when you take your eyes off your goal.
author: Henry Ford

text: The greater the obstacle, the more glory in overcoming it.
author: Moliere

text: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
author: Roger Crawford

text: Achieving success is a challenge but so is struggling so you may as well choose success.
author: Rob Liano

text: Only those who dare to fail greatly can ever achieve greatly.
author: Robert F. Kennedy

text: Our very survival depends on our ability to stay awake, to adjust to new ideas, to remain vigilant and to face the challenge of change.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: It's not that I'm so smart, it's just that I stay with problems longer.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Worry never accomplishes anything. When you have a problem, it is best to concentrate on the solution to that problem, not the problem itself.
author: Thomas D. Willhite

text: Don't be distracted by criticism. Remember - the only taste of success some people have is when they take a bite out of you.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: When obstacles arise, you change your direction to reach your goal; you do not change your decision to get there.
author: Zig Ziglar

text: With everything that has happened to you, you can either feel sorry for yourself or treat what has happened as a gift. Everything is either an opportunity to grow or an obstacle to keep you from growing. You get to choose.
author: Wayne Dyer

text: The greatest obstacle to discovery is not ignorance - it is the illusion of knowledge.
author: Daniel J. Boorstin

text: Genius is a plodding intellect, incapable of dreaming up the obstacles that stop the rest of us.
author: Robert Breault

text: If you find a path with no obstacles, it probably doesn't lead anywhere.
author: Frank A. Clark

text: Obstacles can't stop you. Problems can't stop you. Most of all, other people can't stop you. Only you can stop you.
author: Jeffrey Gitomer

text: All the world is full of suffering. It is also full of overcoming.
author: Helen Keller

text: Faith sees the opportunity; doubt sees the obstacles. What you see is what you get!
author: James MacDonald

text: But the cure for most obstacles is, Be decisive.
author: George Weinberg

text: Do not let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
author: John Wooden

text: Believe in yourself and all that you are. Know that there is something inside you that is greater than any obstacle.
author: Christian D. Larson

text: Obstacles are what you see when you take your eyes off your goals.
author: Brian Tracy

text: I have learned that success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has had to overcome while trying to succeed.
author: Booker T. Washington

text: Press on. Obstacles are seldom the same size tomorrow as they are today.
author: Robert H. Schuller

text: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
author: Confucius

text: Intolerance is itself a form of violence and an obstacle to the growth of a true democratic spirit.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: A barrier is of ideas, not of things.
author: Mark Cane

text: I know fear is an obstacle for some people, but it is an illusion to me . . . Failure always made me try harder next time.
author: Michael Jordan

text: The best people I know have had a lot of obstacles to overcome.
author: Jayne Meadows

text: We will as soon as possible reexamine our laws and policies and eliminate all obstacles to genuine investment.
author: Olusegun Obasanjo

text: If you look at the history of big obstacles in understanding our world, there's usually an intuitive assumption underlying them that's wrong.
author: Jeff Hawkins

text: If at first you don't succeed, try hard work.
author: William Feather

text: Obstacles will look large or small to you according to whether you are large or small.
author: Orison Swett Marden

text: The majority see the obstacles; the few see the objectives; history records the successes of the latter, while oblivion is the reward of the former.
author: Alfred Armand Montapert

text: There are many challenges, there are many obstacles; let us try to change the obstacles to advantages.
author: Harri Holkeri

text: You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
author: A.A. Milne

text: Rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
author: J.K. Rowling

text: You may have to fight a battle more than once to win it.
author: Margaret Thatcher

text: Strength doesn't come from what you can do. It comes from overcoming the things you once thought you couldn't.
author: Rikki Rogers

text: The human capacity for burden is like bamboo - far more flexible than you'd ever believe at first glance.
author: Jodi Picoult

text: You never know how strong you are until being strong is your only choice.
author: Bob Marley

text: Sometimes when you're in a dark place you think you've been buried, but actually you've been planted.
author: Christine Caine

text: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
author: Rumi

text: I can be changed by what happens to me. But I refuse to be reduced by it.
author: Maya Angelou

text: You are not a victim. No matter what you have been through, you're still here. You may have been challenged, hurt, betrayed, beaten, and discouraged, but nothing has defeated you. You are still here!
author: Steve Maraboli

text: The struggle you're in today is developing the strength you need for tomorrow.
author: Robert Tew

text: Hard times don't create heroes. It is during the hard times when the 'hero' within us is revealed.
author: Bob Riley

text: What defines us is how well we rise after falling.
author: Unknown

text: Sometimes the bad things that happen in our lives put us directly on the path to the best things that will ever happen to us.
author: Nicole Reed

text: You were given this life because you are strong enough to live it.
author: Ain Eineziz

text: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford

text: The oak fought the wind and was broken, the willow bent when it must and survived.
author: Robert Jordan

text: You are confined only by the walls you build yourself.
author: Andrew Murphy

text: A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

text: Every adversity, every failure, every heartache carries with it the seed of an equal or greater benefit.
author: Napoleon Hill

text: Stars can't shine without darkness.
author: Unknown

text: It's not the load that breaks you down, it's the way you carry it.
author: Lou Holtz

text: Your current situation is not your final destination. The best is yet to come.
author: Unknown

text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
author: Japanese Proverb

text: The moment you're ready to quit is usually the moment right before the miracle happens. Don't give up.
author: Unknown

text: You have been assigned this mountain to show others it can be moved.
author: Mel Robbins

text: A ship in harbor is safe, but that's not what ships are built for.
author: John A. Shedd

text: Even the finest sword plunged into salt water will eventually rust.
author: Sun Tzu

text: If they can make penicillin out of moldy bread, they can make something out of you.
author: Muhammad Ali

text: The master has failed more times than the beginner has even tried.
author: Stephen McCranie
